documentTitle: ICAO Doc 4444 PANS-ATM (Procedures for Air Navigation Services - Air Traffic Management)

sections.notes: §4.3.2.1 Transfer family: arriving and departing control-transfer clauses, nested conditions, and supporting note. Parent + mutually-exclusive sibling shape (a/b).
§4.5.7.5 Readback family: parent clause, subordinate list (a/b/c), notes, and following standalone clauses (4.5.7.5.1.1, 4.5.7.5.2, 4.5.7.5.2.1).

§7.9 Control of Departing Aircraft: §7.9.1 Departure sequence (with priority factors a-f), §7.9.2 Separation of departing aircraft (the 'crossed end of runway / started a turn' rule), §7.9.3.1-7.9.3.5 Take-off clearance (timing, ATC clearance prerequisite, TAKE-OFF phraseology rule, 'immediate take-off' clearance). Includes inline Note text and figure-layout artifacts.

§7.10 Control of Arriving Aircraft: §7.10.1 Separation of landing aircraft (mirrors §7.9.2), §7.10.2 Clearance to land timing/runway-designator rule, §7.10.3 Landing and roll-out manoeuvres (a-d list of optional instructions, HEAVY aircraft constraint, vacate-report rule).
